summaries.name: the user's rose bush
summaries.summary: The user's rose bush was pruned about a month ago (as of 2023-05-21) and is already producing new buds. It is likely still in its blooming season. Recommended care: deadhead wilted flowers anytime, do light pruning to shape the bush and remove weak or crossing stems to promote more blooms and air circulation, and save more extensive pruning for the dormant season (winter or early spring).
